WITH classified AS (
  SELECT ticket_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%bill%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%bill%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%refund%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%refund%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%price%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%price%' THEN 'Billing'
      WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%2fa%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%2fa%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%sso%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%sso%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%locked%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%locked%' THEN 'Login and access'
      WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%parcel%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%parcel%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%order%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%order%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%shipping%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%shipping%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%tracking%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%tracking%' THEN 'Shipping and delivery'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS theme
  FROM workspace.exam_x0b871.tickets
)
SELECT theme, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, MIN(ticket_id) AS example_ticket_id
FROM classified
WHERE theme IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY theme
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC;
